why: B-S12 (R-3, LAW §9, B0): every directory walk and computed-path read in tests/, tests-visual/ and scripts/ goes onto F-1's file set. Two readers, one rule each: tests/harness/source.ts reads source (F-1's file set; a path the set does not hold fails the read), and tests/harness/artifacts.ts reads everything that is not source (a build output, a run's output, a path outside the repository) and refuses a code file in a zone, so a non-source read can never hide a reference into the tree. A script that reads source reads the floor door's openTree (the same file set). F-1 itself is corrected where it counted a write as a read. Dead readers are deleted, not converted

files.tests/harness/source.ts: the source reader: files/read/sourceStat over F-1's file set, edges, cssOrder; `stat` is renamed sourceStat (an fs name read as an fs call by F-1); the root is derived from import.meta.url so a Playwright spec and a node script load it; the non-source readers move to artifacts.ts
files.tests/harness/artifacts.ts: new: the one non-source reader (artifact, artifactText, artifactExists, artifactStat, artifactFiles); it refuses a code file in one of the five zones or a root config, and a missing artifact fails every read
files.scripts/structure/lib/graph/script.mjs: F-1: a path helper called with a computed argument is a write when the helper writes or the call stands where a write takes its path (`screenshot({ path: frame(…) })`); it was counted as a computed read
